item.title: Nature Methods: Live imaging of neuronal dynamics in transparent mouse brains
item.description: Nature Methods, Published online: 12 March 2026; doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03022-z Making live mammalian tissues transparent for imaging experiments without compromising their normal cellular functions has been a long-standing challenge. An isotonic and minimally invasive optical clearing medium for live mammalian cells and tissues (named SeeDB-Live) paves the way for deep-tissue live imaging of cellular functions ex vivo and in vivo.
